Manipal's leading gym built with absolute intent and zero compromises.

Gravity Fitness in Vidyaratna Nagar, Manipal, Udupi is a well-equipped gym offering a dedicated space for strength training, fitness, and workout enthusiasts. The gym provides a range of modern equipment and facilities designed to support different fitness goals, from regular workouts to serious strength training.

Location and Overview:

Gravity Fitness is located in Vidyaratna Nagar, Manipal, Udupi, and is easily accessible from different parts of Manipal. The gym offers a comfortable and well-equipped environment for individuals looking to maintain an active and healthy lifestyle.

With a focus on quality equipment and a dedicated workout environment, Gravity Fitness caters to beginners as well as experienced fitness enthusiasts. Its convenient location makes it an accessible choice for people living and studying in and around Manipal.

Products and Services Offered:

Gravity Fitness provides a variety of gym equipment and workout facilities to meet the fitness requirements of its members. The facility includes 25+ machines from reputed fitness brands, making it suitable for strength training, muscle building, cardio, and general fitness.

The gym is open 6 days a week, from 5:30 AM to 10:00 PM, giving members flexibility to choose a workout time that fits their schedule.
